_comment: Locked-in slack lambda from the fixed_duration_dial sweep (results/0902c): lambda=0.008 gives AGV busy=55%, machine util=17%, AGV waiting-for-route=10% -- clear slack, no saturation, but enough AGV activity to see LPT_MMUR/LRT_MMUR diverge from the other 7 rules. Duration bumped 15000s -> 30000s (2x) for a proper rule-comparison sample size, repeats restored to 3 (this is now the real data-collection run, not fast dial-in iteration). dynamicJobCap=0 required -- unlimited arrivals for the full duration, matching the dial-in. REQUIRES --baselinedrain true on the launch command (the dial-in's original 4000s run showed near-zero throughput without it -- see 0902b vs 0902c).
